entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought a while back.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your order number, please?

Thank you. I see the Urban Sprinter cycling shoes, delivered about 50 days ago. To make sure I understand, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

It's the fit. I've tried everything, adjusting the cleats, different socks, you name it. But these cycling shoes just keep giving me terrible blisters on my heels after any ride longer than ten miles.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I've confirmed that your order is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. I'm sending the return shipping label to the email on file right now.

Okay, a full refund is good. I appreciate that. But since I did have to deal with the discomfort and now have to go through the hassle of repackaging and shipping, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? I still need to buy another pair.

I understand your position. While I am not authorized to provide discount codes for returns of this nature, I can assure you that you will receive the full refund for the item as soon as it's received back at our warehouse. We can also provide a consultation with one of our gear specialists to help you find a different model that won't cause the same fit issues.
Alright, that's fair. The full refund is the most important part. I'll look out for that email with the label. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. Once you drop the package off, the refund should be processed within 5-7 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
